items.problem: Bootstrap omitted linked shared project items, leading to manual shell reconstruction, lost RequestedTheme/layout fidelity, and a missing resource dictionary.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1; session-log.txt csproj lines 604-724 versus .bootstrap-meta.json lines 501-507; migration-score.json visual notes for all four features.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copied physical descendants only rather than resolvable csproj Include/Link items.
items.change: Resolve common project properties, materialize external linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/None files at their Link paths, include them in rewrite/triage, and surface the linked copy count.
items.expected_effect: Shared shell XAML, theme declarations, code, styles, and assets enter the mapping automatically and are transformed rather than manually recreated.
items.falsifiable_check: On a WiFiScan rerun, bootstrap mapping includes linked App.xaml/MainPage/Styles and assets, App.xaml retains RequestedTheme="Dark", and the all-feature visual theme discrepancy is absent.

items.problem: Launch diagnostics missed ordinary dotnet output and misdirected 0xc000027b XAML-resource failures.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json items 2 and 4; session-log.txt lines 4258-4261, 4524-4529, 4852-4857, and turn 50.
items.root_cause: Hard-coded platform-qualified layout assumptions and an incomplete native stowed-exception mapping.
items.change: Search recursively for the newest complete layout under bin and make merged ResourceDictionary/resource deployment the first 0xc000027b diagnostic.
items.expected_effect: The normal -Target workflow reaches the real app layout and gives an actionable first diagnostic for native XAML resource crashes.
items.falsifiable_check: After a plain dotnet build, Test-AppLaunch.ps1 -Target no longer reports layout unavailable; a forced 0xc000027b result mentions ResourceDictionary resolution before API deferral.

items.problem: Nullable-enabled target scaffolds produced a large, repetitive CS86xx cleanup without focused migration guidance.
items.root_cause: Current WinUI templates enable nullable analysis while legacy UWP device lifecycle code assumes non-null fields assigned after async initialization.
items.change: Add a nullable anchor and route CS86xx warnings to it, covering initialized stable state, nullable acquired handles, guarded callbacks, and nullable PropertyChanged.
items.expected_effect: Agents resolve nullable warnings coherently without disabling analysis or scattering unsafe null-forgiving operators.
items.falsifiable_check: On a legacy device-dependent UWP rerun, the first nullable-warning pass applies the anchor and reaches zero CS86xx warnings without setting Nullable=disable.
